Ugh, same. For tonight, I’d go with one of these easy wins:

- Egg fried rice with frozen veg — about 35g carbs, super fast, very low effort
- Turkey or bean chili in a bowl — about 38g carbs, cozy and filling
- Big quesadilla with cheese + chicken or beans — about 30–40g carbs depending on tortilla
- Pasta with garlic, spinach, and a little protein — about 40g carbs if you keep the portion moderate

If you want the least-brainpower option: egg fried rice. If you want, I can also turn one of these into a super specific “do this tonight” mini recipe.
